project.name: zstd
project.commit_note: The staged `patch.diff` is commit `b0e8580dc7f71881361f3a6fe46841af9d70bedf` (`fix fuzz issue 5131069967892480`). It adds `&& LIKELY(ip + cur < iend)` to the lookahead condition in `lib/compress/zstd_opt.c`, matching the missing obligation traced below. Stage 02 did not execute a fixed build, so this grounding is source-level rather than runtime-validated.

classification.classification_note: The crash is not a classic out-of-bounds fault. The optimal parser performs a one-byte lookahead past the valid end of a buffered block, so `ZSTD_rawLiteralsCost()` reads an allocated but still-uninitialized heap byte from zstd's workspace input buffer.

bug_description.original:
Detailed Report: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=5131069967892480

Project: zstd
Fuzzing Engine: libFuzzer
Fuzz Target: dictionary_stream_round_trip
Job Type: libfuzzer_msan_zstd
Platform Id: linux

Crash Type: Use-of-uninitialized-value
Crash State:
  ZSTD_rawLiteralsCost
  ZSTD_compressBlock_opt2
  ZSTD_compressBlock_btultra2

Sanitizer: memory (MSAN)
Reproducer Testcase: https://oss-fuzz.com/download?testcase_id=5131069967892480
bug_description.normalized: The exact staged witness is the 877-byte file at `gt_results/arvo_66510/poc` (SHA-256 `bb0818b382f566f426806fd8fe8d771bbb088e8fe83e95ecdaab65b59d43cf67`). Replaying `FUZZ_dataProducer` semantics on that file shows `FUZZ_dataProducer_reserveDataPrefix()` splits it into a 479-byte data prefix and a 396-byte producer suffix. The producer suffix drives zstd stream parameters; the saved MemorySanitizer stack proves that the crashing block was dispatched through `ZSTD_compressBlock_btultra2 -> ZSTD_compressBlock_opt2 -> ZSTD_compressBlock_opt_generic`. During stream initialization zstd allocates a heap workspace via `ZSTD_cwksp_create()` and reserves `inBuff` inside that workspace. Buffered streaming then copies only the valid block bytes into `inBuff` and later compresses exactly that extent. In the vulnerable `optLevel=2` lookahead path, `ZSTD_compressBlock_opt_generic()` checks only `optLevel >= 1`, `prevMatch.litlen == 0`, and `LL_INCPRICE(1) < 0` before computing `LIT_PRICE(ip+cur)`; it does not verify `ip + cur < iend`. On the witnessed boundary case, `ip + cur == iend`, so `ZSTD_rawLiteralsCost()` dereferences `literals[0]` from the first untouched workspace byte immediately after the copied block and MemorySanitizer reports `use-of-uninitialized-value` at `lib/compress/zstd_opt.c:285`. The staged fix adds the missing `ip + cur < iend` guard at this exact site.

source.description: First project-code statement that turns the exact fuzz file into two vulnerability-relevant states: a raw payload prefix that will be streamed into zstd, and a producer suffix that will be consumed from the end of the file to steer compression parameters.
source.value_from: The staged witness is exactly 877 bytes. Replaying this helper on the PoC yields `producerSliceSize = 396`, so the helper returns `size = 479` and contracts `producer` to the last 396 bytes. The first 479 bytes remain as the streamed input payload; the last 396 bytes become the parameter stream consumed by later `FUZZ_dataProducer_*` calls.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

sink.description: MemorySanitizer crash site. `ZSTD_rawLiteralsCost()` reads `literals[0]` to index `litFreq`; on the witnessed path `literals == iend`, so this expression consumes the first untouched workspace byte immediately after the copied input block.
sink.note: The saved MSan trace reports `MemorySanitizer: use-of-uninitialized-value` at `lib/compress/zstd_opt.c:285:28` with callers `ZSTD_compressBlock_opt_generic -> ZSTD_compressBlock_opt2 -> ZSTD_compressBlock_btultra2`.

root_cause.description: Root cause. The high-mode lookahead branch lacks any `ip + cur < iend` bound check before pricing one more literal, so the end-of-block boundary remains eligible for a one-byte lookahead that does not exist.
root_cause.note: The staged fix commit adds `&& LIKELY(ip + cur < iend)` to this exact condition before the `LIT_PRICE(ip+cur)` calls.

parser_admitted.description: After step 1 has fixed the raw payload length at 479 bytes, the harness feeds that payload into zstd's streaming compressor. The saved crash stack shows this same compression session later reaching `ZSTD_buildSeqStore` and `ZSTD_compressBlock_btultra2`.

tainted_value_origin.description: MemorySanitizer origin of the uninitialized storage later consumed at the sink. `ZSTD_cwksp_create()` allocates the raw heap workspace that backs zstd's internal input buffer.
tainted_value_origin.value_from: The saved allocation stack is `__interceptor_malloc -> ZSTD_customMalloc -> ZSTD_cwksp_create -> ZSTD_resetCCtx_internal`. Steps 4-6 show how `inBuff` aliases this workspace and only a prefix is written before the sink reads the next byte.

fine_trace.note: Source. This helper consumes bytes from the end of the exact 877-byte PoC and deterministically splits it into a 479-byte raw payload prefix plus a 396-byte producer suffix. The payload prefix is what `compress()` streams into zstd; the producer suffix is the separate attacker-controlled state used for parameter generation.

Each call to this helper drains bytes from the contracted producer suffix and writes them into the compression context. The harness invokes it before streaming starts and may invoke it again after a finished frame (`dictionary_stream_round_trip.c:107-109`); the saved MSan crash stack proves that on the crashing block the active producer-controlled strategy had selected the `ZSTD_compressBlock_btultra2` arm.

During stream initialization, zstd allocates a fresh heap workspace sized for the current streaming session. The saved MSan origin stack names this exact allocation chain as the creation point of the poisoned byte later consumed at the sink.
Buffered streaming aliases part of that raw workspace heap as `inBuff`, the internal source buffer later passed to block compression.

Buffered mode copies exactly `loaded` payload bytes into `inBuff` and advances the initialized prefix by that amount. This statement does not initialize anything beyond the copied extent, so any later read at the next byte would consume whatever state remained in workspace memory there.

For the crashing buffered block, zstd forwards exactly `iSize` bytes from `inBuff` into block compression. That establishes the valid source extent as `[src, src + iSize)`; the saved MSan origin later proves that the byte at `src + iSize` on this witness path still carried the original workspace poison.

fine_trace.code: return ZSTD_compressBlock_opt2(ms, seqStore, rep, src, srcSize, ZSTD_noDict);
fine_trace.note: The witnessed run enters the `btultra2` block compressor on this buffered block. The saved MSan crash stack directly names `ZSTD_compressBlock_btultra2 -> ZSTD_compressBlock_opt2 -> ZSTD_compressBlock_opt_generic`, so this is the concrete dispatch arm that receives the extent from step 6.

fine_trace.code: return ZSTD_compressBlock_opt_generic(ms, seqStore, rep, src, srcSize, 2 /* optLevel */, dictMode);
fine_trace.note: The btultra2 arm forwards the same block into the generic optimal parser with `optLevel = 2`. That high optimization level is what makes the later one-byte lookahead branch eligible.

Root cause. In `optLevel = 2` mode this extra lookahead path checks only the three conditions shown here before trying to price one more literal. The vulnerable source never proves `ip + cur < iend`, so the end-of-block boundary remains eligible for a nonexistent next-literal read.

fine_trace.code:
int with1literal = prevMatch.price + LIT_PRICE(ip+cur) + LL_INCPRICE(1);
int withMoreLiterals = price + LIT_PRICE(ip+cur) + LL_INCPRICE(litlen+1);
fine_trace.note: Because step 9 omitted the `ip + cur < iend` guard, this code asks `LIT_PRICE` to score one more literal starting at `ip + cur`. The upstream fix adds that exact bound check, so the relevant failing boundary here is the witnessed `ip + cur == iend` case: a one-byte lookahead beyond the valid extent from step 6.

Sink. `LIT_PRICE(ip+cur)` from step 10 reaches `ZSTD_rawLiteralsCost()` with `litLength == 1`, so the loop reads `literals[0]`. Here `literals == iend`, making `literals[0]` the untouched workspace byte immediately after the copied input block. MemorySanitizer reports this exact read as the `use-of-uninitialized-value` at `lib/compress/zstd_opt.c:285:28`.

poc.trigger: Feed the exact staged 877-byte file at `gt_results/arvo_66510/poc`. Under `FUZZ_dataProducer_reserveDataPrefix()` it splits into a 479-byte payload prefix and a 396-byte producer suffix. During streaming compression, a producer-controlled parameter set reaches the `btultra2` optimal parser on a buffered last block; the missing `ip + cur < iend` guard then lets `LIT_PRICE(ip+cur)` price one nonexistent next literal, and `ZSTD_rawLiteralsCost()` reads the first untouched workspace byte after the copied block.
